summary: Grupo Cibest S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the elimination of its Payments, Cash Flows and Insurance Vice Presidency held by Liliana Patricia Vásquez Uribe, and the creation of a similar position at its subsidiary Bancolombia S.A., with her appointment. The changes were approved by the board and effective immediately. No price, premium, or financial terms are involved. The announcement represents an abrupt senior management reorganization, qualifying as a forced/abrupt departure event. No advisors or regulatory timeline are disclosed. Watch for potential further management turnover or subsidiary governance shifts.
